My dear [Mr Shipley](/person/1315),
I am afraid that such an awful subject would not suit with anything so light as the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), and that I had therefore better return it which I will do the next time I send into Winchester, I send you the prospectus of a cheap [missionary magazine](/periodical/94), which [Miss Mackenzie](/person/930) hopes to make very interesting

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
[In different handwriting on the second half of the sheet]
Dear Mr Bramley
I am very sorry for this Suppose you write to the [Churchman Family](/periodical/63) (Bride’s Avenue, Fleet St, Hogg & Son) by return of post & offer the MS - say it is suitable for Lent & must appear then V. Orby Shipley
